description: Switch the git user.name / user.email per project from saved profiles, with the active profile shown in the status bar.
config.enabled: Enable Git Profile Switcher for this workspace.
config.profiles: Saved git profiles (alias, name, email). Shared across all projects.
config.profiles.color: Status bar text color when this profile is active, hex like #ff8800. Optional.
config.language.auto: Follow the VS Code display language.
